sections.title: Sound of the letter effe
paragraphs: The letter is named (effe) /ɛf/. Its main sound is heard in (film) /film/, which means movie. This letter can make two sounds, or it can be silent.

sections.title: How to say the letter
paragraphs: For the first sound, rest your upper teeth gently on your lower lip. Blow air through the narrow space without using your voice. Touch your throat to check that it does not shake. For the second sound, keep the same mouth position. Turn your voice on so your throat vibrates.

sections.title: Spelling rules for the letter
paragraphs: In most words, the letter sounds like the consonant in (café) /ka.fe/. In liaison before a vowel sound, it changes to a voiced sound, as in (neuf ans) /nœ.vɑ̃/. A liaison is a final consonant that you say only when the next word starts with a vowel. The letter is a silent letter in a few words, such as (clef) /kle/ or (nerfs) /nɛʁ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: This letter usually sounds like the f in English fat. Do not make the sound too weak or let both lips touch like blowing out a candle. Always keep your upper teeth resting lightly against your lower lip.
